# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through [GitHub's private Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/ai-refusal-map/security/advisories/new). Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

You can expect an acknowledgment within 48 hours and a resolution timeline once the issue is confirmed.
